import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class MCMF {
        static final int N = 30000;
        static final int M = 7010010;
        int[] h = new int[N];
        int[] ing = new int[N];
        int[] pre = new int[N];
        int[] to = new int[M];
        int[] ne = new int[M];
        long[] cap = new long[M];
        long[] dis = new long[N];
        long[] cost = new long[M];
        int e, s, t, n;
        static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;

        void initialize(int _n) {
            Arrays.fill(h, -1);
            n = _n;
            e = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long c, long w) {
            to[e] = v;
            ne[e] = h[u];
            cap[e] = c;
            cost[e] = w;
            h[u] = e++;
        }

        void connect(int u, int v, long c, long w) {
            addEdge(u, v, c, w);
            addEdge(v, u, 0, -w);
        }

        boolean spfa() {
            Arrays.fill(dis, INF);
            Arrays.fill(ing, 0);
            Queue<Integer> Q = new LinkedList<>();
            Q.offer(s);
            ing[s] = 1;
            dis[s] = 0;
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int c = Q.poll();
                ing[c] = 0;
                for (int k = h[c]; k >= 0; k = ne[k]) {
                    if (cap[k] > 0) {
                        int v = to[k];
                        if (dis[c] + cost[k] < dis[v]) {
                            dis[v] = dis[c] + cost[k];
                            pre[v] = k;
                            if (ing[v] == 0) {
                                Q.offer(v);
                                ing[v] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return dis[t] != INF;
        }

        long flow, mincost;

        Pair<Long, Long> execute(int _s, int _t) {
            s = _s;
            t = _t;
            flow = 0;
            mincost = 0;
            while (spfa()) {
                long minFlow = INF;
                for (int p = t; p != s; p = to[pre[p] ^ 1]) {
                    minFlow = Math.min(minFlow, cap[pre[p]]);
                }
                for (int p = t; p != s; p = to[pre[p] ^ 1]) {
                    cap[pre[p]] -= minFlow;
                    cap[pre[p] ^ 1] += minFlow;
                }
                mincost += minFlow * dis[t];
                flow += minFlow;
            }
            return new Pair<>(flow, mincost);
        }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public final U first;
        public final V second;

        public Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    static final long INF = Long.MAX_VALUE;
    static int[] a = new int[55];
    static int[][] id = new int[55][2500];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }

        MCMF flow = new MCMF();
        int totalNodes = 50 * 50 * 4 + 10;
        flow.initialize(totalNodes);
        int s = flow.n - 2;
        int t = flow.n - 1;

        int cnt = 0;
        int mx = 100;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= mx; j++) {
                id[i][j] = ++cnt;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < mx; j++) {
                for (int h = 1; h <= k; h++) {
                    int tmp = h * h * d - (h - 1) * (h - 1) * d;
                    flow.connect(id[u][j], id[v][j + 1], 1, c + tmp);
                    flow.connect(id[v][j], id[u][j + 1], 1, c + tmp);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < mx; j++) {
                flow.connect(id[i][j], id[i][j + 1], INF, c);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            flow.connect(s, id[a[i]][0], 1, 0);
        }

        for (int j = 1; j <= mx; j++) {
            flow.connect(id[1][j], t, INF, 0);
        }

        Pair<Long, Long> result = flow.execute(s, t);
        System.out.println(result.second);
    }
}
